initial.state: Large initial backlog with no current-run history
initial.lesson: Test the measured spatial/worst/random .30, mixed best/random POSITION, greedy initial neighborhood when compatible with the live state. Both TASK selectors stay random. This complete control improved service after common continuation on both development sets; merely adding random positions to the old .40 control did not. Do not infer a universal repair advantage. The probes used best-position consolidation afterward, not indefinite mixed-position repetition; inspect the next residual state before choosing continuation.

rationale.reason: Test the complete initial spatial neighborhood supported by two development batches, then evaluate residual service before deciding how to consolidate the routes.

consolidate.state: One observed mixed-position initial window from a large backlog; service remains incomplete
consolidate.lesson: The retrieved probe's downstream advantage was measured with best-position repair and spatial/random/time .40, tolerant.02 after the first mixed-position window. Compare that consolidation hypothesis with the current residual gap and rejection feedback. Initial service improvement does not establish that mixed positions should continue indefinitely. Energy tolerance is a bounded hypothesis, not evidence that the present run has an energy barrier. Keep the best service vector and judge the next measured window; later behavior is selected from live feedback.

rationale.reason: Compare best-position consolidation after the observed initial mixed-position neighborhood; retain service protection and evaluate the next residual-service outcome.
